title: Security Audit Overview
description: Canonical security audit triage and investigation. Alert-routing copies are excluded to prevent double counting.

config.title: Total audit events
config.description: Canonical audit events in the selected time range and filters.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM acer-audit-* METADATA _index | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND NOT (_index LIKE "acer-audit-alerts-*") AND NOT (labels.audit_source.keyword IN ("traefik", "oauth2-proxy", "keycloak") AND event.action IS NULL) | STATS events = COUNT(*)

config.title: High-signal events
config.description: Canonical alerts plus Wazuh level 11+ events in the selected time range.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM acer-audit-* METADATA _index | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND NOT (_index LIKE "acer-audit-alerts-*") AND NOT (labels.audit_source.keyword IN ("traefik", "oauth2-proxy", "keycloak") AND event.action IS NULL) AND (labels.audit_alert IS NOT NULL OR (labels.audit_source.keyword == "wazuh" AND app.rule.level >= 11)) | STATS events = COUNT(*)

config.title: Wazuh audit events
config.description: Normalized endpoint and host audit events supplied by Wazuh.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM acer-audit-* METADATA _index | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND NOT (_index LIKE "acer-audit-alerts-*") AND NOT (labels.audit_source.keyword IN ("traefik", "oauth2-proxy", "keycloak") AND event.action IS NULL) AND labels.audit_source.keyword == "wazuh" | STATS events = COUNT(*)

config.title: Active audit sources
config.description: Distinct audit sources observed in the selected time range.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM acer-audit-* METADATA _index | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND NOT (_index LIKE "acer-audit-alerts-*") AND NOT (labels.audit_source.keyword IN ("traefik", "oauth2-proxy", "keycloak") AND event.action IS NULL) | STATS sources = COUNT_DISTINCT(labels.audit_source.keyword)

config.title: Audit events over time
config.description: Event volume by source. Sudden drops can indicate collection loss; spikes can indicate activity requiring a pivot.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM acer-audit-* METADATA _index | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND NOT (_index LIKE "acer-audit-alerts-*") AND NOT (labels.audit_source.keyword IN ("traefik", "oauth2-proxy", "keycloak") AND event.action IS NULL) | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), source = labels.audit_source.keyword | SORT bucket ASC

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM acer-audit-* METADATA _index | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND NOT (_index LIKE "acer-audit-alerts-*") AND NOT (labels.audit_source.keyword IN ("traefik", "oauth2-proxy", "keycloak") AND event.action IS NULL) | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY source = labels.audit_source.keyword | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 10

config.title: Source freshness
config.description: Oldest last-seen source is shown first so collection gaps stand out.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM acer-audit-* METADATA _index | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND NOT (_index LIKE "acer-audit-alerts-*") AND NOT (labels.audit_source.keyword IN ("traefik", "oauth2-proxy", "keycloak") AND event.action IS NULL) | STATS events = COUNT(*), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY source = labels.audit_source.keyword | SORT last_seen ASC

config.title: Recent high-signal events
config.description: Newest canonical alerts plus Wazuh level 11+ events; historical rows are classified at query time without rewriting audit documents.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM acer-audit-* METADATA _index | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND NOT (_index LIKE "acer-audit-alerts-*") AND NOT (labels.audit_source.keyword IN ("traefik", "oauth2-proxy", "keycloak") AND event.action IS NULL) AND (labels.audit_alert IS NOT NULL OR (labels.audit_source.keyword == "wazuh" AND app.rule.level >= 11)) | EVAL priority = CASE(labels.alert_severity IS NOT NULL, labels.alert_severity, app.rule.level >= 14, "critical", app.rule.level >= 12, "high", app.rule.level >= 11, "medium", "unclassified"), alert_signature = CASE(labels.audit_alert IS NOT NULL, labels.audit_alert, app.rule.level >= 14, "wazuh-critical", app.rule.level >= 12, "wazuh-high-severity", "wazuh-investigation-required") | SORT @timestamp DESC | KEEP @timestamp, priority, app.rule.level, alert_signature, labels.audit_source, labels.team, actor.name, host.name, event.action, event.outcome, event.code, url.path | LIMIT 100

config.title: Recent proxy access
config.description: Newest normalized Traefik and oauth2-proxy requests. Actor is populated only when the source reports an authenticated identity.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM acer-audit-* METADATA _index | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND NOT (_index LIKE "acer-audit-alerts-*") AND NOT (labels.audit_source.keyword IN ("traefik", "oauth2-proxy", "keycloak") AND event.action IS NULL) AND labels.audit_source.keyword IN ("traefik", "oauth2-proxy") AND http.request.method IS NOT NULL | SORT @timestamp DESC | KEEP @timestamp, labels.audit_source, actor.name, source.ip, http.request.method, http.response.status_code, event.outcome, url.domain, url.path | LIMIT 100

config.title: Authentication failures
config.description: Failed oauth2-proxy and Keycloak authentication events by source and status.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM acer-audit-* METADATA _index | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND NOT (_index LIKE "acer-audit-alerts-*") AND NOT (labels.audit_source.keyword IN ("traefik", "oauth2-proxy", "keycloak") AND event.action IS NULL) AND labels.audit_source.keyword IN ("oauth2-proxy", "keycloak") AND event.outcome == "failure" | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY source = labels.audit_source.keyword, status = http.response.status_code | SORT events DESC

config.title: Top requested paths
config.description: Most requested normalized proxy paths in the selected range.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM acer-audit-* METADATA _index | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND NOT (_index LIKE "acer-audit-alerts-*") AND NOT (labels.audit_source.keyword IN ("traefik", "oauth2-proxy", "keycloak") AND event.action IS NULL) AND labels.audit_source.keyword IN ("traefik", "oauth2-proxy") AND url.path IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY path = url.path.keyword | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 10

config.title: Identity and privileged activity
config.description: Keycloak authentication plus Vault and Teleport privileged activity.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM acer-audit-* METADATA _index | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND NOT (_index LIKE "acer-audit-alerts-*") AND NOT (labels.audit_source.keyword IN ("traefik", "oauth2-proxy", "keycloak") AND event.action IS NULL) AND labels.audit_source.keyword IN ("keycloak", "vault", "teleport") | SORT @timestamp DESC | KEEP @timestamp, labels.audit_source, actor.name, source.ip, event.action, event.outcome, url.path | LIMIT 100

config.title: Wazuh host security
config.description: Newest normalized Wazuh endpoint and host security events.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM acer-audit-* METADATA _index | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND NOT (_index LIKE "acer-audit-alerts-*") AND NOT (labels.audit_source.keyword IN ("traefik", "oauth2-proxy", "keycloak") AND event.action IS NULL) AND labels.audit_source.keyword == "wazuh" | SORT @timestamp DESC | KEEP @timestamp, app.rule.level, host.name, event.action, event.code, observer.name | LIMIT 100

config.title: Full audit timeline
config.description: Newest canonical audit events for the current time range and filters.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM acer-audit-* METADATA _index | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend AND NOT (_index LIKE "acer-audit-alerts-*") AND NOT (labels.audit_source.keyword IN ("traefik", "oauth2-proxy", "keycloak") AND event.action IS NULL) | SORT @timestamp DESC | KEEP @timestamp, labels.audit_source, labels.service, actor.name, host.name, event.action, event.outcome, message | LIMIT 200
